summary: Adds chat permission controls, improves computer-use feedback, and refines profile activity and settings navigation.

items.title: Chat permissions and tool approvals
items.description: The icon-only composer selector offers Ask for approval, Approve for me, and Full access. Settings now includes a persistent Always full access option; when enabled, it hides the selector and applies Full access to new and queued runs. Main and custom-agent tools enforce the selected mode: Ask for approval pauses actions, Approve for me permits routine web searches and eligible workspace edits while other actions wait for review, and Full access retains current tool access. Approvals can apply once or to the same action for the current run, and can be rejected, cancelled, or expire.

items.title: Usage activity loading
items.description: The Profile token activity chart uses one soft shimmer across the chart, with matching loading rows for All chats and Action usage. Existing data remains visible during refreshes, and reduced-motion mode shows static placeholders.

items.title: Computer-use reliability and feedback
items.description: Desktop and window captures use the correct scope and receive images directly from CUA Driver. Click and typing inputs use the installed driver's supported format, and the agent receives a fresh screenshot after input. Older drivers refresh window previews with each observation so controls stay current. Native actions are labeled Computer use, with separate feedback for rejected input, uncertain delivery, and failed follow-up screenshots. Composer settings refresh now runs outside React's render cycle.

items.title: Model provider identification
items.description: Provider logos appear beside models in the model selector to make third-party providers easier to distinguish.

items.title: Settings search and navigation
items.description: The search field uses a borderless style, dropdown rows begin in a neutral state with a gray keyboard-navigation highlight, and subtle theme-matched fades soften the Settings sidebar edges.

items.title: Composer settings refresh
items.description: Moved the chat composer settings refresh out of React's render cycle.
